prompt: Conduct a 3D squarebend flow simulation using OpenFOAM. The computational domain includes multiple regions, with vertices defined as inlet points at (-50, 25, 25) and (-50, 25, -25), outlet points at (-500, -75, 25) and (-500, -75, -25), and mid-bend points like (25, 0, 25) and (25, 0, -25). Follow the same geometry as the tutorial. Use a start time of 0 seconds, an end time of 500 seconds, a time step of 1 second, and write results every 100 seconds. Use a massflow rate inlet of 0.5 with turbulentBL profile. Outlet is pressureInletOutletVelocity. Temperature has an inlet value of 1000. Pressure is fixed at 110000 Pa at the outlet (zero-gradient at the inlet), and the domain is initialised to 110000 Pa. use kepsilon turbulence model. Use rhoSimpleFoam solver. Use Pr value of 1.0. Use mu value of 1.82e-5. Do not use more than 120000 cells in your mesh.
adopted_interpretations: 源rhoSimpleFoam为稳态；controlDict结束500和dt是迭代控制，不解释成500s瞬态。仅迭代步差异的变体物理范围重复，保留独立源标识。
原prompt省略完整管形，按blockMesh毫米尺度和圆弧补全。
turbulentBL源名称未给数学函数；移植采用明确1/7幂次最近壁距剖面，属于作者公开规范化，不能宣称与原插件剖面逐点完全相同。
R取通用气体常数除以源molWeight=28.9，Cp=1005；出口回流T/k/epsilon按0目录1000/1/200。
120000单元为源网格预算（源块数总112000），当前评测资源未校准；不将其当执行时间/内存限制。
